onset.Description: Actual onset of the events accounting for the presentation delays

duration.Description: Total duration of the events (some videos were repeated)

trial_type.Description: Event type presented during the task

Levels.fixation: Fixation marker consisting of three concentric circles presented at the middle of the screen

onset_schedule.Description: Onset of the event as pre-defined in the paradigm

repetition.Description: Number of times a video was repeated

ran.Description: Boolean indicating whether or not a video was presented

order.Description: Order of the event per trial_type

index.Description: Index of the video from the original ratings file

category.Description: Name of the category with the highest score (proportion reported)

approach.Description: To what extent does this make you feel like this is something you would want to approach? (desire to avoid… desire to approach) (1…9)

arousal.Description: To what extent does this make you feel stimulated? (more subdued… more stimulated) (1…9)

attention.Description: To what extent does this make you feel focused? (more unfocused… more focused) (1…9)

certainty.Description: To what extent does this make you feel certain? (very uncertain… very certain) (1…9)

commitment.Description: To what extent does this make you feel a sense of commitment to an individual or creature? (lack of commitment to an individual/creature …strong commitment to an individual/creature) (1…9)

control.Description: To what extent does this make you feel like things are under control? (things seem out of control… things seem under control) (1…9)

dominance.Description: To what extent does this make you feel dominant? (more submissive… more dominant) (1…9)

effort.Description: To what extent does this make you feel like viewing this demands effort? (no effort whatsoever… enormous effort) (1…9)

fairness.Description: To what extent does this make you feel like things are fair? (sense of unfairness… sense of fairness) (1…9)

identity.Description: To what extent does this make you feel like you identify with a group of people? (lack of group identity… strong group identity) (1…9)

obstruction.Description: To what extent does this make you feel like you are obstructed by something? (very unobstructed… very obstructed) (1…9)

safety.Description: To what extent does this make you feel a sense of safety? (very unsafe… very safe) (1…9)

upswing.Description: To what extent does this make you feel like this went better than it first seemed it would? (worse than expected… better than expected) (1…9)

valence.Description: To what extent does this make you feel pleasant? (very unpleasant… very pleasant) (1…9)
